events.speaker: caller
events.text: Dallas County Sheriff's Office. You missed federal jury duty and there's a bench warrant.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: I understand, but the warrant is active. You can post a bond by phone to avoid going to jail tonight.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: You'll get MoneyPak vouchers, then read me the numbers.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I need to call a lawyer.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Don't. If you disconnect, officers come out within the hour.
